student_learning_goal: I can calculate change in cents.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can calculate change in cents.
header.character_watermark: Pat the Pup in the top-right with a snack and clipboard. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.visual_layout: Four transaction boxes with cents prices and pay amounts.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 cents-change layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 4 transactions: 1) Cookie 60¢ pay $1, 2) Sticker 25¢ pay 50¢, 3) Apple 80¢ pay $1, 4) Pencil 35¢ pay 50¢. Each with cents answer slot.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P1_CENTS at Part 1: keywords name the cents transactions task.

parts.visual_layout: Two coin workspaces with change amount labels.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 coin-change layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 2 workspaces: 1) Show 25¢ in coins, 2) Show 40¢ in coins.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P2_COINS at Part 2: keywords name the coins change drawing task.

parts.answer_key: 25¢ = 1 quarter or 2 dimes + 1 nickel; 40¢ = 4 dimes or 1 quarter + 1 dime + 1 nickel.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 single-cents layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 'Cookie 35¢, pay 50¢.' Below: subtraction workspace and answer line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P3_ONE at Part 3: keywords name the cents change calculation task.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, calculate change for 95¢ paid $1.
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 consolidation. Formative — check ¢ vs $ unit clarity. Part 1 uses 4 NEW cents amounts (Eraser 45¢ pay 50¢, Gum 65¢ pay 75¢, etc.) not in the lesson demo — verifies cents-only subtraction generalises.
